c-ffb00c54.name: Sales Pipeline
c-ffb00c54.description: Tracks open sales opportunities progressing through deal stages, covering pipeline generation, stage movement, territory assignment, forecast classification, and stalled/ageing deal health. The core lens for GTM sales execution and quarter-level pipeline review.

execution_hints.definition: Active opportunities where STAGE_NAME is not Closed Won or Closed Lost
execution_hints.time_grain: quarter
execution_hints.default_filter: EXCLUDE_FROM_SALES_PIPELINE = FALSE

c-c2a5529f.name: Sales Bookings
c-c2a5529f.description: Adding new edges: two archived booking volume metrics (AVG Booking and Bookings Dynamic) and two deal-size ASP metrics (Bookings ASP and Addressable ASP) from the Analytics & Data insight layer — covering both aggregate booking volume and average deal size for closed-won deals.

c-a56e162c.name: Sales Forecasting
c-a56e162c.description: Models expected revenue outcomes from the active sales pipeline using sales-defined forecast categories and a dedicated forecasting model. Supports quarter-end planning, exclusion of non-addressable deals, and GTM operations alignment.

execution_hints.definition: Forward-looking view of pipeline expected to close within the current or next evaluation quarter
execution_hints.time_grain: quarter
execution_hints.default_filter: EXCLUDE_FROM_SALES_PIPELINE = FALSE

c-a8d736df.name: Sales Rep Performance
c-a8d736df.description: Measures individual account executive effectiveness across win rates, territory coverage, average selling price, and opportunity ownership. Provides quarterly and rolling views for coaching, quota attainment tracking, and territory planning.

execution_hints.time_grain: quarter
execution_hints.definition: Opportunity outcomes attributed to PRIMARY_ACCOUNT_EXECUTIVE or OPPORTUNITY_OWNER_NAME

c-b143d3b5.name: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR)
c-b143d3b5.description: Adding new edges: two ARR report datasets (product-level ARR report and the shared DWH SST ARR report), and three ARR snapshot metrics covering the Analytics product-line ARR, the cross-product most-recent ARR, and the total ARR aggregate.

c-30591dce.name: Customer Churn & Downgrade
c-30591dce.description: Tracks customers who have cancelled or reduced their Optimizely subscriptions. Includes downgrade amounts, annual price contraction, CSM accountability, and product-level churn signals. Connects to the CMP dormancy framework and stalled renewal opportunities.

execution_hints.definition: Accounts with DOWNGRADE_AMOUNT > 0 or lost renewal opportunities
execution_hints.time_grain: monthly

c-ab4eedd6.name: Customer Renewal
c-ab4eedd6.description: Manages and tracks renewal opportunities for existing Optimizely customers at contract expiry. Includes product-line renewal opportunities, ICP prioritisation of renewal effort, and the link between renewal pipeline health and churn outcomes.

execution_hints.definition: Opportunities of type Renewal where CLOSE_DATE is within the renewal window
execution_hints.time_grain: quarter

c-30fc2a3f.name: Opal AI Platform Usage
c-30fc2a3f.description: Adding new edges: three canonical DWH daily-usage datasets (product-account level, user-account level, and fine-grained feature-interaction), one user-built daily Opal usage view, a per-user thread-volume dataset, a user-level Opal Understand daily summary view, and the SST Max Date metric that governs data-freshness boundaries for Opal usage reporting.

c-de319aa6.name: Opal AI Content Generation
c-de319aa6.description: Adding new edges: the Opal Agents per Thread dataset (agent invocation breadth per conversation), the core Opal Generation Data event stream, a daily agent-account generation usage dataset, a raw generation records view, and a granular agent-level detail dataset for the Opal Understand sub-product — collectively covering the generative output layer of the Opal platform.

c-dca3b201.name: Product Engagement
c-dca3b201.description: Measures whether paying Optimizely accounts are actively using the products they subscribe to. Segments accounts into engaged vs. non-engaged states and tracks the ARR at risk from low engagement. Covers the Analytics product line and the broader CMP (Customer Maturity Profile) framework with Casual, Core, and Dormant tiers.

execution_hints.definition: An account is 'engaged' if it has at least one qualifying product interaction in the measurement month
execution_hints.time_grain: monthly

c-cc815ee3.name: A/B Experimentation
c-cc815ee3.description: Adding new edges: the AI Assisted Experiments dataset (primary registry for AI-created experiments), the AI Assisted Experiments Summary event (analyst view of AI-experiment outcomes), the Opal Experimentation Analysis Cohorts dataset (cohort-based analysis of Opal-influenced experimentation behaviour), and the Exp Purple Button Clicked metric (a tracked UI engagement signal within the experimentation product dashboard).

c-3ae07eba.name: Opal Onboarding
c-3ae07eba.description: Adding new edges: the canonical Opal Onboarding Snapshots dataset (timestamped onboarding state records), the Opti Analytics Raw Identifies event (raw Segment identify-call events capturing the first-identity moment for new OA/Opal users), and the in-progress Onboarding Data WIP dataset (analyst view of product onboarding step progression).

c-610385ef.name: Customer Success Management
c-610385ef.description: Adding new edges: the Uservoice Metrics dataset (product feedback and feature request tracking) and the Zendesk Ticket Metrics dataset (support ticket volumes and service metrics) — both systems are explicitly referenced in the existing Customer Success Management concept description.

c-1911e9d1.name: ICP Account Targeting
c-1911e9d1.description: Identifies and classifies accounts as Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) matches for prioritised sales, marketing, and renewal efforts. The ICP flag is a cross-cutting dimension used across new pipeline generation, product opportunity management, and renewal prioritisation.

c-c703ebe4.name: Marketing Demand Generation & SDR Funnel
c-c703ebe4.description: Tracks the end-to-end marketing-sourced demand generation and SDR outreach funnel from initial company/contact identification through MQL status to pipeline creation. Seven datasets share MCID/ACCOUNT_ID join keys and together cover: SDR multi-channel outreach activities (channel, outcome, playbook executed), MQL progression history, account sourcing attribution, funnel-stage classification, and firmographic segmentation (industry, employee bands, ownership). Enables analysis of which marketing sources and SDR plays convert most effectively into qualified pipeline.

execution_hints.definition: Count MQL-stage accounts/contacts progressing through SDR outreach to pipeline; segment by ACCOUNT_SOURCE, CUSTOMER_STAGE_C, COM_CHANNEL, and OUTCOME
execution_hints.time_grain: CREATED_DATE for funnel entry; CONTACT_DATE in GS_MARKETING_FULL_FUNNEL_SDR_CONTACT_HISTORY for outreach activity cadence
execution_hints.default_filter: CUSTOMER_STAGE_C IN ('MQL','SAL','SQL') to focus on active funnel stages; exclude CUST_LOST12/CUST_LOST24 churned accounts from conversion rate denominators

c-f70e4ec8.name: Conversation Intelligence
c-f70e4ec8.description: Captures structured insights extracted from sales conversations via the ZRA (Zoom Revenue Accelerator) platform. Fields include competitors mentioned, product features discussed, key business topics, AI-generated conversation summaries, internal Optimizely participant lists, and external prospect/customer participants. Supports competitive intelligence gathering, rep coaching, and deal-level signal analysis across the sales motion.

execution_hints.definition: Aggregate competitor mentions, features, and indicators by rep, account, or time period; join on NAME to SFDC_OPPORTUNITY for deal-level attribution
execution_hints.time_grain: Per conversation (ZVC__ZRA_CONVERSATION__C as the grain identifier)
execution_hints.default_filter: Filter by ZVC__INTERNAL_PARTICIPANT_LIST__C to scope to AE or SDR-specific conversation pools

c-d42acaed.name: Customer Risk Intervention (CTA)
c-d42acaed.description: Tracks Gainsight Call-to-Action (CTA) records representing discrete, triggered risk interventions for at-risk customer accounts. Each CTA quantifies ARR exposed to risk (CTA_ARR), the reason that triggered the alert (REASON_NAME), the intervention playbook type (BRAVE_TYPE_GC), the contract renewal date establishing urgency, and the owning account manager. Two datasets provide campaign-level contact detail and an account-level summary roll-up, enabling CS leadership to monitor portfolio-wide intervention coverage, ARR at risk by territory, and playbook effectiveness.

execution_hints.definition: Sum CTA_ARR by REASON_NAME, BRAVE_TYPE_GC, and TERRITORY_GC to identify the largest pools of at-risk ARR and the intervention playbooks deployed; track CTA resolution rate over time
execution_hints.time_grain: CONTRACT_RENEWAL_DATE proximity (CTAs renewing within 30/60/90 days) for urgency triage
execution_hints.default_filter: OPTI_ID_STATUS = 'Active' (or equivalent open status) to exclude resolved interventions from current-state reporting

c-64a37312.name: Opal AI Credit Management
c-64a37312.description: Tracks the credit economy powering Optimizely's Opal AI platform — covering credit allotments (budget pools assigned to organisations with start/expiry dates and priority tiers) and fine-grained credit consumption per usage event. The two datasets together enable burn-rate analysis, budget exhaustion forecasting, and per-user credit attribution across the Opal product. Distinct from engagement/activity tracking in Opal AI Platform Usage.

execution_hints.definition: Join GS_OPAL_CREDIT_ALLOTMENTS_OUTPUT to GS_OPAL_FINE_GRAINED_USAGE_OUTPUT on ORGANIZATION_ID + MASTER_CUSTOMER_ID. Burn rate = SUM(CREDITS_CONSUMED) / CREDITS grouped by ALLOTMENT_KEY.
execution_hints.time_grain: Daily event-level (USAGE_DATE) with allotment-period context (ALLOTMENT_START to ALLOTMENT_EXPIRY)
execution_hints.default_filter: Filter ALLOTMENT_EXPIRY >= CURRENT_DATE for active allotments

c-65b84990.name: GTM Demand Qualification (DQ) Pipeline
c-65b84990.description: Tracks the systematic bucket-based qualification, assignment, and progression of accounts through Optimizely's GTM demand qualification process. Accounts are classified into named buckets, assigned to reps by role, and monitored weekly for movement direction (upgrade/downgrade) and backlog age. Four datasets — current bucket state, weekly bucket movement, a Gainsight GTM rep-assignment view, and a weekly backlog — collectively support pipeline health visibility, rep coverage analysis, and stale-account identification.

execution_hints.definition: Join DQ_BUCKET_MOVEMENTS to DQ_Account_Buckets on ACCOUNT_ID for state+movement analysis. Join GS_GTM_DQ_ACCOUNT_BUCKETS on ACCOUNT_ID for rep-level views. Use WEEK_START for weekly time-series.
execution_hints.time_grain: Weekly (WEEK_START)
execution_hints.default_filter: Exclude accounts where CUSTOMER_STAGE = 'Churned' for active pipeline analysis

c-3e6a8fd4.name: Renewal Rate Reporting
c-3e6a8fd4.description: An executive-level reporting suite measuring Optimizely's renewal performance across multiple analytical dimensions: by product group, by product solution, and by individual customer. Five datasets drawn from both the DWH and analytics layers provide ARR renewal and churn rate metrics segmented by digital maturity, territory, region, and CSM. QBR_CREATED flags signal account engagement health. This is the primary data surface for exec-deck renewal health reviews — distinct from the operational management of individual renewals.

execution_hints.definition: Renewal Rate % = ARR_RENEWAL / (ARR_RENEWAL + ARR_CHURN). Join all five datasets on MASTER_CUSTOMER_ID for customer-level analysis. Use DATE_YQ for quarterly exec review cadence.
execution_hints.time_grain: Monthly (DATE_YM) and Quarterly (DATE_YQ)
execution_hints.default_filter: DIGITAL_MATURITY is a consistent segmentation dimension across all five datasets

c-f0f63ad8.name: Product Contract Utilization
c-f0f63ad8.description: Measures how much of their contracted product entitlement Optimizely customers are actually consuming. Combines a monthly usage time-series (MONTHLY_USAGE vs. CONTRACT_USAGE) with a product-account mapping that includes partner flags, turnstile entitlement gates, and contract date ranges. CONTRACT_YEAR_INDEX enables cohort analysis by contract vintage. Distinct from engagement scoring — this is quantitative utilization rate against contracted volume, surfacing over- and under-consumption patterns.

execution_hints.definition: Utilization Rate = MONTHLY_USAGE / CONTRACT_USAGE per PRODUCT per USAGE_MONTH. Join All_Prodcut_Usage to Product - Accounts on MASTER_CUSTOMER_ID.
execution_hints.time_grain: Monthly (USAGE_MONTH)
execution_hints.default_filter: Filter to active contracts: CONTRACT_START_DATE <= CURRENT_DATE <= CONTRACT_END_DATE

c-4c065aa7.name: Sales Targets & Quota
c-4c065aa7.description: Captures the goal-setting layer of Optimizely's GTM sales motion — quarterly pipeline generation and bookings targets broken down by territory, segment, product group, customer type, and super-region. PIPE_GEN_GOAL and BOOKINGS_GOAL are the primary planning metrics. Enables actual-vs-target variance analysis when joined with Sales Pipeline actuals and Sales Bookings data. Distinct from the tracking of actuals in either pipeline or bookings concepts.

execution_hints.definition: Attainment % = Actuals / Goal. Join Sales Bookings actuals to SFDC_PIPE_GENERATION_BOOKINGS_TARGETS on TERRITORY + DATE_QUARTER + SEGMENT for attainment reporting.
execution_hints.time_grain: Quarterly (DATE_QUARTER)
execution_hints.default_filter: Filter CUSTOMER_TYPE to isolate new business vs. expansion quota lines

c-2da30e13.name: Customer Product Onboarding
c-2da30e13.description: Tracks structured Gainsight-managed onboarding engagements delivered to customers post-sale, across all Optimizely product lines. Each record represents a discrete onboarding element (ELEMENT_NAME) within a named engagement (ENGAGEMENT_NAME), linked to the originating Salesforce opportunity (OPPORTUNITY_ID) and segmented by PRODUCT_SKU and PRODUCT_GROUP. STAGE and CLOSED_DATE_C track completion status. Broader than Opal Onboarding — covers Gainsight-structured onboarding journeys for all Optimizely products.

execution_hints.definition: Completion rate = COUNT(STAGE = 'Closed') / COUNT(ELEMENT_ID) per MCID per PRODUCT_GROUP. Join on MCID or OPPORTUNITY_ID to link to account and deal records.
execution_hints.time_grain: Event-level with CLOSED_DATE_C for time-bounded completion analysis
execution_hints.default_filter: Filter by PRODUCT_GROUP to scope to specific product onboarding programmes; join on OPPORTUNITY_ID for sales-close-to-onboarding lag analysis

c-d3ec0a35.name: Feature Adoption Tracking
c-d3ec0a35.description: Tracks which specific Optimizely product features each customer account has adopted or has yet to adopt. Two dedicated datasets provide a positive adoption matrix (features confirmed in use per account) and a gap view (features not yet adopted), enabling CS and product teams to identify feature whitespace, guide adoption conversations, and prioritise product-led growth motions. Segmented by product group, technology maturity, Opti One bundle status, and environment. Joined to the customer master via MASTER_CUSTOMER_ID.

execution_hints.definition: An account has 'adopted' a feature when MASTER_CUSTOMER_ID appears in Feature Adoption Matrix Account for that FEATURE_NAME. A gap exists when the same MASTER_CUSTOMER_ID + FEATURE_NAME appears in Features Not Adopted Account.
execution_hints.time_grain: Account-level snapshot; no explicit date column — likely refreshed on a periodic cadence
execution_hints.default_filter: Filter Features Not Adopted by PRODUCT_GROUP to scope gap analysis to a specific product line

c-2b052d62.name: Customer Health Monitoring
c-2b052d62.description: Aggregates multi-signal health indicators at the customer account level to support proactive CS intervention. Health scores, 30-day active user counts, total licensed user access, product instance counts, and contract end proximity are combined to produce a composite picture of account vitality. CHURN_DATE enables retrospective validation of health score predictiveness. The same HEALTH_SCORE field appearing in both the user activity dataset and the feature adoption dataset allows cross-signal corroboration. Used by CSMs and account executives to triage at-risk accounts ahead of renewal.

execution_hints.definition: Active user ratio = ACTIVE_USERS_30D / TOTAL_USERS_WITH_ACCESS; HEALTH_SCORE is the pre-computed composite. Join Active_Users_Projects_Workspaces and Feature Adoption Matrix Account on MASTER_CUSTOMER_ID to compare health signals across both sources.
execution_hints.time_grain: Account-level snapshot; CHURN_DATE and EARLIEST_CONTRACT_END_DATE enable time-to-event and days-to-renewal calculations
execution_hints.default_filter: Exclude accounts with CHURN_DATE populated when reporting on current active portfolio health

c-606d3797.name: Account Universe & Firmographic Profile
c-606d3797.description: The master firmographic reference layer covering both current Optimizely customers and non-customer prospect accounts. Customer Accounts and Non Customer Accounts share a parallel column structure (employee count, revenue banding, annual revenue, industry) joined via MASTER_CUSTOMER_ID/CUSTOMER_ID. Non Customer Accounts extends to ACCOUNT_SUB_INDUSTRY for finer prospect segmentation unavailable in the customer table. Together these datasets underpin GTM territory planning, ICP classification, demand generation targeting, and customer-vs-prospect comparison across the total addressable market.

execution_hints.definition: UNION Customer Accounts and Non Customer Accounts on shared firmographic columns to build a unified account universe; tag rows with a customer/prospect flag before unioning
execution_hints.time_grain: Static reference tables; no date dimension — joins are point-in-time
execution_hints.default_filter: ICP_ACCOUNT = TRUE in Customer Accounts filters to the priority renewal and expansion population

c-29131c0f.name: Opti ID & Product Instance Management
c-29131c0f.description: Tracks the lifecycle and migration status of Optimizely product instances per customer organisation. Three datasets form a coherent cluster: the Turnstile instance registry (which product instances are active per org, their STATUS, CREATED_DATE, and DELETED state), the Opti ID enablement status per instance (OPTI_ID_ENABLED), and an org-to-master-customer bridge resolving TS_ORG_ID to MASTER_CUSTOMER_ID. Together they answer: which customers have which product instances, which instances have migrated to the unified Opti ID identity layer, and how Turnstile org identities map to the canonical customer key used across all OA datasets.

execution_hints.definition: An Opti ID-enabled instance is one where OPTI_ID_ENABLED = TRUE in Opti ID Migration Statuses joined to Turnstile via INSTANCE_ID
execution_hints.time_grain: Point-in-time snapshot; CREATED_DATE enables cohort analysis of when instances were provisioned; DATE_PLACEHOLDER provides alignment date context
execution_hints.default_filter: DELETED = FALSE in Product - Turnstile Instances Flattened to restrict to live instances

c-b529538f.name: Customer Financial Identity & Hierarchy
c-b529538f.description: Represents the financial and legal entity structure of Optimizely customers as recorded in NetSuite (billing system of record). Captures parent-child account relationships (PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID → CUSTOMER_ID), the ultimate enterprise roll-up (TOP_LEVEL_PARENT_MASTER_CUSTOMER_ID), subsidiary naming, primary billing currency, and the Salesforce CRM linkage (CELIGO_AT_SALESFORCE_ID). Distinct from the Account Universe concept which covers GTM firmographics; this concept resolves how billing entities nest within enterprise hierarchies and how NetSuite CUSTOMER_IDs map to the canonical MASTER_CUSTOMER_ID used as the primary join key across all OA datasets.

execution_hints.definition: Join via MASTER_CUSTOMER_ID to resolve NetSuite billing entities to the canonical customer identifier used across OA datasets; use TOP_LEVEL_PARENT_MASTER_CUSTOMER_ID for full enterprise-group aggregations
execution_hints.time_grain: Slowly-changing dimension with no explicit timestamp column — treat as current-state snapshot; ENTITY_ID provides a stable surrogate key

c-fa9f4306.name: Experiment Project Collaboration
c-fa9f4306.description: Tracks the human layer of Optimizely's experimentation activity: which users are collaborating on which experimentation projects, their platform roles (ROLE_NAME), organisational job functions (JOB_DEPARTMENT, JOB_ROLE), and the customer accounts they belong to. DWH_CS_COLLABORATOR is the primary dataset, joinable to OA_EXPERIMENTATION_UNIFIED and DWH_CS_EXPERIMENT_METRICS_ALL_CUSTOMERS via PROJECT_ID. Enables persona-based adoption analysis (which job departments and roles run experiments), stakeholder mapping per account, and identification of single-collaborator or zero-collaborator projects as early engagement-risk signals for CS teams.

c-8f8e993a.name: Professional Services Delivery
c-8f8e993a.description: Tracks the delivery of professional services engagements at Optimizely using the Kimble PSA platform. Delivery Groups (KIMBLE_DELIVERY_GROUP_C) represent discrete service projects with owner assignment and billing currency, while Delivery Elements (KIMBLE_DELIVERY_ELEMENT_C) are the granular work items or milestones within each group, linked via KIMBLE_ONE_DELIVERY_GROUP_C. Together they provide a hierarchical view of PS project structure and scope — distinct from the Gainsight-managed product onboarding covered in Customer Product Onboarding, which is a post-sale structured enablement journey rather than a billable services delivery engagement.

execution_hints.definition: Kimble Delivery Group as the unit of a PS engagement; Elements are milestones or tasks within that group
execution_hints.time_grain: Per project / delivery group lifecycle (CREATED_DATE to LAST_MODIFIED_DATE)

c-dee6fd20.name: Opportunity Product Mix & Pricing
c-dee6fd20.description: Captures the product-level composition of Salesforce opportunities by linking each deal to its constituent line items with quantity, discount, and pricebook entry. SFDC_PRODUCT provides the active product catalog (IS_ACTIVE, PRODUCT_CODE, DESCRIPTION), while SFDC_OPPORTUNITY_LINE_ITEM joins products to opportunities via OPPORTUNITY_ID and PRODUCT_2_ID, exposing which products are bundled in each deal and at what volume and discount rate. Enables deal-structure analysis, bundle reporting, discount governance, and product mix trending across the sales pipeline — distinct from Sales Bookings (which tracks aggregate closed deal value) and Product Contract Utilization (which tracks consumption vs. contracted volume post-sale).

execution_hints.definition: Join SFDC_OPPORTUNITY_LINE_ITEM.PRODUCT_2_ID to SFDC_PRODUCT.ID; filter SFDC_PRODUCT.IS_ACTIVE = true for current catalog analysis
execution_hints.time_grain: Per opportunity / per line item
execution_hints.default_filter: SFDC_OPPORTUNITY_LINE_ITEM joined via OPPORTUNITY_ID to closed-won opportunities for bookings mix; to open opportunities for pipeline mix

c-c990b866.name: Opal GTM Cross-Sell Performance
c-c990b866.description: Measures the effectiveness of Opal's sales motion within the existing CMP and Experimentation customer base on a per-rep, per-quarter basis. Two parallel Gainsight snapshots (25Q3 and 25Q4) track open and closed Opal deal counts per rep alongside their CMP and Exp deal activity, with the pivotal 'Open CMP & Exp Deals Has Opal' vs. 'No Opal' split quantifying the Opal cross-sell attach rate into existing customers. This is the primary GTM lens for Opal pipeline expansion — distinct from Sales Rep Performance (which covers general win rates and ASP across all products) and Opal AI Platform Usage (which tracks product engagement post-sale).

execution_hints.definition: Opal attach rate = Closed Opal deals / (Open CMP & Exp Deals Has Opal + Open CMP & Exp Deals No Opal); join both quarterly datasets on USERNAME and TERRITORY_C for trend analysis
execution_hints.time_grain: Quarterly (Q3 2025 and Q4 2025 snapshots)
execution_hints.default_filter: TERRITORY_C for regional breakdowns; USERNAME for individual rep drill-down

c-e5ae80de.name: Product ARR Bridge & Opal Cannibalization
c-e5ae80de.description: Analyses product-level ARR movement using a waterfall/bridge methodology that decomposes ARR changes by product group, pathway, and region. 'Product - ARR Churn' provides snapshot-dated, constant-currency FX-adjusted (CCFX) ARR changes at product group level with PRODUCT_BRIDGE as a structural classification key. 'GS_SST_PRODUCT_BRIDGE_PRODUCT_GROUP_EROSION_REGIONAL_BRIDGE' adds regional segmentation and the pivotal OPAL_CANNIBALIZATION vs. OPAL_INCREMENTAL split — directly quantifying whether Opal revenue displaces existing Optimizely product ARR or represents genuine net new revenue. Both datasets are joined via PRODUCT_BRIDGE and SNAPSHOT_DATE. Distinct from Customer Churn & Downgrade (account-level cancellations and CSM accountability) and Renewal Rate Reporting (rate-based exec metrics); this is a product-portfolio ARR waterfall used by finance and product strategy to assess portfolio health and Opal's net revenue contribution.

execution_hints.definition: Net Opal contribution = OPAL_INCREMENTAL - OPAL_CANNIBALIZATION; bridge joins on PRODUCT_BRIDGE + SNAPSHOT_DATE across both datasets
execution_hints.time_grain: Monthly snapshot (SNAPSHOT_DATE)
execution_hints.default_filter: SNAPSHOT_DATE = max(SNAPSHOT_DATE) for current state; PRODUCT_GROUP or REGION for drill-down

c-561d438d.name: Feature Experimentation (FX) Usage & Entitlement
c-561d438d.description: Tracks operational usage and plan entitlement for Optimizely's Feature Experimentation (FX) product — the feature-flag and progressive-delivery layer that is distinct from traditional web A/B testing. FX Flag Raw data is the flag registry per account and project, capturing each customer's flag inventory with revision history, archival state, and outlier-filtering configuration. DWH_CS_EXPERIMENTATION_USAGE records impression-based consumption (IMPRESSIONS) against contracted plan limits (USAGE_LIMIT) across billing periods, enabling plan utilization analysis and overage risk detection. ACCOUNT_ID is the shared join key. Distinct from A/B Experimentation (which tracks experiment execution and statistical results) and Product Contract Utilization (which tracks broader multi-product contracted volume).

execution_hints.definition: FX utilization rate = IMPRESSIONS / USAGE_LIMIT per billing period; active flag count = count(FLAG_ID) where IS_ARCHIVED = false per ACCOUNT_ID
execution_hints.time_grain: Monthly billing period (PERIOD_START_DATE to PERIOD_END_DATE in DWH_CS_EXPERIMENTATION_USAGE)
execution_hints.default_filter: IS_ARCHIVED = false in FX Flag Raw data for active flag inventory; current or rolling 3-month periods for usage trend

c-81194d68.name: GTM Account Coverage & Team Assignment
c-81194d68.description: Captures the structured mapping of GTM team members (SVP, Account Executive, Customer Success Manager, SDR variants) to each Optimizely account, alongside the account's customer lifecycle stage and territory. GS_MARKETING_CONTACTS is the primary dataset providing per-account named role assignments joined via ACCOUNT_ID. SFDC_USER_ROLE supplies the underlying Salesforce role hierarchy (PARENT_ROLE_ID chain and FORECAST_USER_ID for quota roll-up structure), enabling validation of proper coverage depth and manager-to-rep attribution. Together they support coverage gap analysis (accounts without assigned AE or CSM), territory balance reviews, and alignment between customer stage and the appropriate coverage model — distinct from Marketing Demand Generation & SDR Funnel, which covers outreach activity and funnel progression rather than structural role assignments.

execution_hints.definition: Coverage gap = accounts in GS_MARKETING_CONTACTS with null AE or null CSM field; role hierarchy depth resolved via SFDC_USER_ROLE.PARENT_ROLE_ID chain
execution_hints.time_grain: Point-in-time snapshot (refreshed periodically — no explicit date grain in columns)
execution_hints.default_filter: CUSTOMER_STAGE in active or at-risk states for coverage prioritisation; TERRITORY_NAME for regional coverage analysis

c-9c11ecdb.name: Partner Ecosystem Performance
c-9c11ecdb.description: Measures the operational performance of Optimizely's channel partner network across customer coverage, opportunity generation, product-group implementation activity, and partner-attributed CSAT. PARTNER_PERFORMANCE_SCORE provides aggregate partner scorecards (total customers, opportunities, SKU records, ARC counts, and CSAT record volumes), while PARTNER_PRODUCT_GROUP_AGGREGATE breaks these down by product group, partner region, and partner manager with GOOD/BAD CSAT splits and IMPLEMENTATION_COUNT. Product–Partner Lookup resolves the customer-to-partner relationship via PARTNER_MCID/CUSTOMER_MCID join keys. Together these three datasets enable partner-tier comparison, regional performance benchmarking, and identification of high-performing vs. underperforming partners across Optimizely's channel ecosystem.

execution_hints.definition: Join PARTNER_PERFORMANCE_SCORE to PARTNER_PRODUCT_GROUP_AGGREGATE on PARTNER_ACCOUNT_ID (or PARTNER_NAME). Use Product–Partner Lookup on PARTNER_MCID to resolve customer-level attribution.
execution_hints.time_grain: Snapshot-level (no explicit date column visible — reflects current state at extract time)
execution_hints.default_filter: Segment by PARTNER_TYPE for tier analysis; by PARTNER_REGION for geographic views; by PRODUCT_GROUP_NAME for product-level breakdowns

c-b80de4ba.name: Partner Certification & Enablement
c-b80de4ba.description: Tracks the training, credentialing, and capability investment of Optimizely's channel partners. PARTNER_CERTIFICATION records each partner's enrollment across named certifications, the specific Optimizely product or activity being certified (ACTIVITY_NAME_OR_PRODUCT), enrollment lifecycle stage (ENROLLEMENT_STATUS), binary completion flag (IS_ENROLLMENT_COMPLETED), and the count of certified personnel the partner has deployed (NUMBER_OF_RESOURCES). This enables Optimizely's channel and partner management teams to identify under-certified partners, prioritise enablement investment, and assess product-specific certification coverage across the partner network. Joined to Partner Ecosystem Performance via PARTNER_NAME.

execution_hints.definition: Grain is one row per partner × certification combination. IS_ENROLLMENT_COMPLETED = true defines certified partners; NUMBER_OF_RESOURCES measures bench depth per certification.
execution_hints.time_grain: Snapshot-level; ENROLLEMENT_STATUS captures in-progress certifications for pipeline view
execution_hints.default_filter: IS_ENROLLMENT_COMPLETED = true for certified-partner analysis; ACTIVITY_NAME_OR_PRODUCT to slice by Optimizely product line

c-c1121d27.name: Opal Agent Registry
c-c1121d27.description: The master reference catalog for all Opal AI agents available on the Optimizely platform, spanning out-of-the-box (OOTB) agents shipped with the product and custom agents built for specific use cases. Captures canonical agent names, agent type classification, release dates, and a date-filter scoping window — forming the definitional dimension layer used to normalise agent identity across Opal usage and content generation analytics. The Opal Product Mapping table provides raw-to-canonical product name resolution, enabling accurate attribution of runtime usage events and generative output to specific agent types and sub-products. Distinct from Opal AI Platform Usage (which tracks dynamic session and thread activity against these agents) and Opal AI Content Generation (which records generative output volumes per agent).

execution_hints.definition: UNION Product - Opal OOTB Agents and Product - Custom Agents on NAME_KEY / CANONICAL_NAME to build a unified agent dimension. LEFT JOIN Product - Opal Product Mapping on RAW_PRODUCT_NAME to resolve canonical PRODUCT_NAME before joining to usage fact tables.
execution_hints.time_grain: Agent release cohort (RELEASE_DATE); DATE_FILTER column controls temporal eligibility window

c-ee6d805d.name: CS Team Organizational Hierarchy
c-ee6d805d.description: Captures the four-level management reporting chain within Optimizely's Customer Success organisation, sourced from Salesforce: individual CSMs (level 1), their direct line managers (CSM Manager, level 2), VP-level CS leaders (level 3), and SVP-level executives (level 4). The shared MANAGER_ID foreign key chains each layer to the next, enabling attribution of account-level outcomes — churn, renewal rate, health score — up the management stack. This is the structural org-chart reference layer for the CS team, used for leadership roll-up reporting, territory-level aggregation, and manager-level accountability in renewal rate and CTA dashboards. Distinct from GTM Account Coverage & Team Assignment, which maps named GTM personnel to specific customer accounts rather than capturing internal reporting relationships.

execution_hints.definition: Join SFDC_CUSTOMER_USER_CSM.MANAGER_ID → SFDC_CUSTOMER_USER_CSM_MANAGER.ID → SFDC_CUSTOMER_USER_VP.ID → SFDC_CUSTOMER_USER_SVP.ID to build a 4-level hierarchy. Each level exposes {LEVEL}_NAME and {LEVEL}_TITLE for roll-up labelling.
execution_hints.time_grain: Static org snapshot sourced from Salesforce; refresh cadence should align with CS re-org events

c-4bc1e571.name: Employee Office Attendance & Return-to-Office Compliance
c-4bc1e571.description: Tracks Optimizely employees' physical office access and return-to-office (RTO) compliance using data sourced from the Brivo building-access-control platform. Each record represents an individual employee identified by ACTOR_ID and EMAIL, with their department, hire date, total office days accessed in the measurement window, and a computed Compliance % against the attendance target. This is an internal people-operations dataset entirely separate from customer-facing product analytics — it surfaces workforce attendance patterns, department-level RTO compliance rates, and tenure-cohort comparisons of in-office behaviour. No join path to customer datasets exists in this metadata batch.

execution_hints.definition: Compliance % = Days Accessed ÷ Target Days in Period × 100. Group by DEPARTMENT for team-level views; bucket EMPLOYEE_HIRE_DATE into tenure bands (< 1 yr, 1–3 yrs, 3+ yrs) for cohort analysis.
execution_hints.time_grain: Monthly or quarterly attendance window; DAYS_IN_OFFICE and Days Accessed are cumulative counts within the reporting period

c-c574a48b.name: Pipeline Quality & Deal Velocity
c-c574a48b.description: Measures the health of Optimizely's sales pipeline through deal age metrics, velocity benchmarks, and end-of-quarter snapshots. Three dedicated datasets work in concert: (1) PIPELINE_QUALITY_END_OF_QUARTER_SNAPSHOT captures opportunity-level stage, type, and lead-source snapshots per fiscal quarter; (2) PIPELINE_QUALITY_AGE_TREND provides P90_DAYS and MEDIAN_DAYS trending by configurable scope dimensions; and (3) PIPELINE_QUALITY_BENCHMARK supplies WON_P90_DAYS reference standards by stage — the velocity profile of historically closed-won deals. Together these enable identification of stalling or slow-moving deals relative to winning-deal benchmarks. Distinct from Sales Pipeline, which tracks open deal counts and stage progression; this is a diagnostic quality-governance layer applied on top of that core view.

execution_hints.time_grain: fiscal_quarter

c-ad46562e.name: Financial Chart of Accounts (COA)
c-ad46562e.description: Optimizely's internal accounting reference layer for the NetSuite general ledger, comprising four dimension tables: COA Accounts (GL account types, parent-child account hierarchy, department-requirement rules), COA Track Code GL (GL tracking codes with SYNC_TO_ORO and SYNC_TO_NAVAN flags for downstream expense management integration), COA Subsidiaries (legal entity hierarchy with PARENT_SUBSIDIARY rollup, LEGAL_NAME, and BASE_CURRENCY/PARENT_CURRENCY for multi-entity consolidation), and COA Departments (department hierarchy with FINOPS_DEPARTMENT_DESCRIPTION and system sync flags). Together these four tables establish Optimizely's canonical financial dimension structure used to classify all company expenditures and revenues. Distinct from Customer Financial Identity & Hierarchy, which maps Optimizely's customer billing entities and parent-child CRM relationships — this concept is Optimizely's own internal accounting taxonomy.

execution_hints.default_filter: INACTIVE = false (COA Accounts), SUBSIDIARY_IS_INACTIVE = false (COA Subsidiaries), DEPARTMENT_IS_INACTIVE = false (COA Departments) for active reference data
execution_hints.definition: INTERNAL_ID is the primary key joining across COA tables; SYNC_TO_ORO and SYNC_TO_NAVAN flags determine which records flow to expense management systems

c-6b98f077.name: Marketing Contact Engagement & Attribution
c-6b98f077.description: Tracks the effectiveness of Optimizely's marketing activities through two complementary lenses: (1) GS_MARKETING_CONTACT_HISTORY records each marketing contact event per account-contact pair — capturing communication channel (COM_CHANNEL), the playbook or marketing play executed (EVENT_PLAY), contact outcome (OUTCOME, EVENT_SUB_OUTCOME), and event owner; and (2) DWH_MARKETING_ATTRIBUTION links advertising source (AD_SOURCE), campaign identity (CAMPAIGN_ID, CAMPAIGN_NAME, CAMPAIGN_TYPE), and company identifiers to an estimated pipeline revenue value (EST_REVENUE). Together these enable marketing and RevOps teams to evaluate which channels, plays, and campaign programs generate measurable revenue outcomes — an attribution ROI layer distinct from the SDR Funnel concept, which focuses on MQL qualification and funnel-stage progression rather than downstream revenue attribution.

execution_hints.definition: Join GS_MARKETING_CONTACT_HISTORY to DWH_MARKETING_ATTRIBUTION via ACCOUNT_ID (GS) / COMPANY_ID (DWH); CAMPAIGN_ID is a secondary link
execution_hints.time_grain: CONTACT_DATE (event-level in GS); campaign-level attribution in DWH has no explicit time grain in visible columns

c-78ea4219.name: Product In-App Behavioral Analytics
c-78ea4219.description: Captures how users interact with Optimizely's product UI through two complementary behavioral data sources: (1) Segment event data (ACCOUNT_ID, ACTION_LOCATION, AUDIENCE_ID, ANONYMOUS_ID, CAMPAIGN_ID) tracks user actions by product location and audience cohort via the Segment CDP pipeline; and (2) Userflow data (ANNOUNCEMENT_ID/NAME, BANNER_ID/NAME/SESSION_ID, BUTTON_EVENT_NAME) tracks user engagement with in-app announcements, banners, and guidance prompts. Together these provide a behavioral and in-app communication signal layer — informing product engagement depth, onboarding step completion, and feature adoption campaign effectiveness. CAMPAIGN_ID in the Segment dataset links product behavioral events to marketing campaigns.

execution_hints.definition: Join Segment and Userflow data via ACCOUNT_ID where available; ANONYMOUS_ID → ACCOUNT_ID resolution required for pre-login events
execution_hints.time_grain: event-level; BANNER_SESSION_ID enables session-level aggregation in Userflow

c-2558432c.name: Experiment Statistical Methodology
c-2558432c.description: Tracks the statistical configuration choices made per experiment across Optimizely's customer base. STATS_MODELS_EXP captures which statistical model type is applied (STATS_MODEL_TYPE), whether variance reduction via CUPED is enabled (IS_CUPED — Controlled-experiment Using Pre-Experiment Data), whether guardrail metrics protect against unintended side-effects (HAS_GUARDRAIL), and whether outlier filtering is active (OUTLIER_FILTERING_ENABLED). Segmented by ACCOUNT_NAME and CREATED_MONTH, this dataset enables Optimizely's data science and CS teams to track adoption of advanced statistical features over time, assess the methodological sophistication of customer experimentation programs, and correlate statistical configuration choices with experiment quality outcomes. Distinct from A/B Experimentation, which tracks experiment execution volume and adoption rates — this is the methodology governance and feature-adoption layer.

execution_hints.time_grain: CREATED_MONTH — monthly cohort view of methodology adoption trends
execution_hints.definition: EXPERIMENT_ID joins to experiment-level datasets in A/B Experimentation; ACCOUNT_NAME joins to account master

Sales Pipeline tracks open, not-yet-closed opportunities progressing through stages. Sales Bookings captures closed-won deal value. Both share OPPORTUNITY_ID but represent different lifecycle moments — pipeline is forward-looking, bookings are realised.

Sales Pipeline is the factual state of all open opportunities. Sales Forecasting is a predictive layer on top of pipeline — which subset is expected to close in a given quarter. The SALES_DEFINED_FORECAST column and EXCLUDE_FROM_SALES_PIPELINE flag are the bridge between these two concepts.

Customer Renewal tracks the opportunity and process to retain customers at contract expiry. Customer Churn & Downgrade measures the actual or anticipated loss of ARR. A failed renewal becomes churn; Stalled & Ageing Pipe is a leading indicator visible in both concepts.

Bookings is the TCV or ACV of newly signed contracts in a period. ARR is the annualised recurring revenue from the entire active customer base. New bookings flow into ARR after contract start, making them related but temporally and definitionally distinct.

Product Engagement classifies accounts into broad CMP engagement tiers (Casual/Core/Dormant) based on overall usage patterns. Feature adoption depth is an input signal to engagement scoring but is a finer-grained, feature-centric analysis.

A/B Experimentation tracks customer usage of the Optimizely experimentation platform specifically. Feature Adoption Tracking covers all Optimizely product features across all product groups; experimentation features may appear within it as one PRODUCT_GROUP, but the concept spans the full product portfolio.

Customer Health Monitoring is the continuous measurement layer — health scores, active user ratios, contract proximity. Customer Risk Intervention (CTA) is the triggered action layer — discrete Gainsight CTAs created when health signals breach defined thresholds. Health monitoring produces the signals that CTAs respond to, but they are different operational constructs.

Account Universe & Firmographic Profile is the raw descriptive reference layer (employees, industry, revenue band) covering both customers and prospects. Sales Pipeline tracks open opportunity counts, stage progression, forecast categories, and territory assignment. Pipeline Quality & Deal Velocity measures deal age (P90/median days in stage) against WON_P90_DAYS benchmarks from historically closed deals — it is a diagnostic health-check layer applied on top of the Sales Pipeline data rather than a restatement of it.

Marketing Demand Generation & SDR Funnel tracks MQL progression, SDR outreach activity, and funnel-stage qualification from initial company identification through to pipeline creation. Marketing Contact Engagement & Attribution focuses on the effectiveness measurement layer — which channels produce which outcomes and which campaigns generate estimated revenue — an ROI evaluation frame rather than a funnel progression frame.

A/B Experimentation tracks experiment execution volume, customer adoption of the experimentation platform, and AI-assisted experiment creation. Experiment Statistical Methodology tracks only the statistical configuration choices within those experiments (model type, CUPED, guardrails, outlier filtering) — the methodology governance layer that informs experiment quality, not the experiments themselves.
Registry dataset for AI-assisted experiments created via the Opal integration — a core experiment type within the A/B Experimentation concept and explicitly mentioned in its description.

Product In-App Behavioral Analytics captures UI-layer user interactions (Segment track events, Userflow banner and button clicks) across all Optimizely products. Opal AI Platform Usage tracks account- and user-level adoption metrics specific to the Opal AI platform. The Segment event stream includes Opal-surface events but is not Opal-exclusive — it spans the full product portfolio and is the behavioral signal layer rather than the platform-adoption layer.

Opal Onboarding tracks the digital onboarding journey for Opal AI users via platform snapshots, Segment identify events, and user-flow step progression. Customer Product Onboarding covers Gainsight-managed structured onboarding engagements across all Optimizely products post-sale, linked to Salesforce opportunities. The 'Product - Onboarding Data - WORK IN PROGRESS' dataset is provisionally placed in Opal Onboarding based on owner context, but may warrant reassignment to Customer Product Onboarding pending schema review.
